title: Witch's Cosmic Ritual
description: A dark surreal scene featuring a silhouetted witch holding a glowing lantern while standing on a swirling multicolored spiral ground. Behind the witch are demonic antlered figures and a tall gothic cathedral tower rising into a swirling cosmic sky filled with vibrant nebulae, stars, and floating circular portals.
prompt: A silhouetted witch with a pointed hat stands on a glowing spiral of concentric rainbow rings holding a lantern that emits pink light. Behind her are several tall demonic creatures with antlers surrounded by green flames. A massive dark gothic cathedral tower rises into a dramatic swirling cosmic sky with orange, purple, teal and red nebulae, stars, and multiple floating circular portals with eye-like centers, dark fantasy surreal painting style
